name: @forest/e2e
description: Forest end to end: two people from two seeds, each with a note from the loop's issuer and a profile record carrying a real note proof on a host; an offer and a message through mcp with access keys their app listed; a deal paid directly and through an escrow with a schedule, both through the fee payer; two reviews naming their evidence; the loop's index counting it all and serving both ratings; and the tutor carrying its rating to a second profile with a reputation proof. Every service on loopback from this repo by default, or the deployed ones a services.json names; the chain is remote.
